description: This file defines API routes for a seeded memory match card game using FastAPI. It includes data models with Pydantic, route handlers for creating a game, fetching the deck, and making match attempts, and interacts with an external service for game logic.

classes.name: CreateGameRequest
classes.description: Input schema for creating a new game session, with optional difficulty and seed.

classes.name: CreateGameResponse
classes.description: Output schema representing the created game session details.

classes.name: Card
classes.description: Schema representing a game card for front-end display, excluding matched state.

classes.name: MatchRequest
classes.description: Input schema for requesting a match between two card IDs.

classes.name: MatchResponse
classes.description: Response schema indicating whether a match was successful, remaining pairs, total moves, and game completion.

methods.name: CreateGameResponse create_game(payload: CreateGameRequest = Body(default=CreateGameRequest()))
methods.description: API route handler to create a new seeded game, returning game metadata.

methods.name: List[Card] get_deck(gameId: UUID = Path(..., description="Game session ID"))
methods.description: API route handler to retrieve current game deck view.

methods.name: MatchResponse post_match( gameId: UUID = Path(..., description="Game session ID"), payload: MatchRequest = Body(...), )
methods.description: API route handler to process a match attempt between two cards.
